intro.text: The region of western Roshar around the Purelake, named after an old Silver Kingdom, whose peoples are called Selay.
One of the Silver Kingdoms of Roshar, which claimed the Purelake, Marabethia, Babatharnam, Yulay and parts of Tu Bayla and Rira.

description.text: Sela Tales held nearly the whole coast of the Purelake, and great rivers ran through it to the Reshi Sea or the lake.
The Selay have bronze skin, dark hair and distinctive ripple patterns on their skin. Some were afterwards ruled by gerontarchs, likely a remnant of the old kingdom.
Selay belongs to the Iri language family, with the languages of Iri, Rira, the Reshi and the Purelake.

items.text: Sela Tales was founded in the Silver Kingdoms epoch. Like the other kingdoms, it was knocked back by each Desolation, sometimes to stone tools.
Early in its history, Panatham became its capital, and later held the Selay Oathgate.
During the Desolations, the Selay built great fortifications, including a stone fortress on the Purelake.

Sometime after Aharietiam, Sela Tales collapsed into several kingdoms, with some regions, like the Purelake, ungoverned. The region kept its name, and after the Recreance the Selay acquired several Shardblades and sets of Shardplate.
